name: Faded Shadowhide Pendant
summary: A tarnished talisman once worn by the Shadowhide gnolls of Redridge, enchanted to serve as a conduit for dark orders. To the astonishment of whoever holds it, the pendant also carries a delayed magical message cast by the wizard Theocritus.

sections.title: A Broken Network
sections.body: The Shadowhide gnolls roaming the Redridge Mountains answer to a sinister master named Morganth, coordinating their movements through enchanted pendants. While investigating these talismans from his sanctuary at Tower Azora, the High Mage Theocritus devised an experimental spell to breach their mystical frequency. Though his magical broadcast took weeks to manifest, this faded pendant proved that the gnolls' communication line can be hijacked, opening a path to disrupt their dark master's reach.

sections.title: The Mage's Ambition
sections.body: Studying the faded pendant in person offers Theocritus far more than just intercepted chatter. By examining how the enchantment weathered his intrusion, the mage hopes to refine his sorcery into a weapon capable of projecting disabling attacks directly through any matching amulets worn across Redridge. Delivering the artifact back to Tower Azora in Elwynn Forest is the vital first step toward dismantling Morganth's hold on the region's gnolls.

faq.q: What is the Faded Shadowhide Pendant?
faq.answer: It is an enchanted amulet originally worn by Shadowhide gnolls in the Redridge Mountains to receive orders from their master, Morganth. This particular pendant has been altered by an intercepted broadcast spell cast by High Mage Theocritus.

faq.q: Why does a voice speak from the pendant?
faq.answer: High Mage Theocritus spent months researching how to magically breach the pendants' communication link. The voice you hear is an echo of a spell he projected weeks earlier, proving his incantation successfully penetrated the gnolls' network.

Theocritus is the High Mage residing at Tower Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. He dedicates his magical studies to monitoring dark threats across the border in Redridge, particularly the rogue sorcerer Morganth.
Morganth is a rogue, sinister magic-user operating out of Redridge. He exerts dark influence over the local Shadowhide gnoll pack, issuing commands to them through these enchanted pendants.

faq.q: What does Theocritus plan to do with the pendant?
faq.answer: Theocritus intends to study the pendant's enchantment in his laboratory. His ultimate goal is to find a way to project disabling magical attacks across the network, instantly incapacitating any gnoll wearing one.

angles.text: The pendant demonstrates the subtleties of magical interception, showing that even crude or dark enchantments can be decoded and hijacked by a disciplined Kirin Tor wizard.
Retrieving this amulet aids Tower Azora in weakening the Shadowhide gnolls that threaten the stability of both Elwynn Forest and Lakeshire.
